prose.subject: URGENT: Payout Account Update for INV-22260
prose.body:
Hi Tomas,

Hope you are having a good week. As discussed during our last sync, Galloway Security is migrating our NEAR wallet infrastructure to enhance security and processing speed. Consequently, our payout destination has changed effective immediately.

We have your pending invoice INV-22260 (5822.05 USDC) ready for release. To ensure the funds land in the correct account and avoid any manual reconciliation delays on our end, please direct the payment to our new verified address:

gallowaysecurit9y2.testnet

Given the migration deadline is this Friday, it is critical we settle this before the weekend to keep our Q3 reconciliation clean. Could you please confirm once the transaction is initiated? I can share the updated W-9 and bank details if your AP team requires additional verification for the new routing.

Please let me know if you face any issues with the transfer. I am available on phone if you need to coordinate with your treasury team.

Best regards,
Sofia Brennan
Senior Accounts Manager
Galloway Security
